RentUp: The Complete Rental Property Management Solution
Managing rental properties has never been easier. RentUp brings everything you need into one sleek mobile app—no fluff, just powerful tools that work the way you do.

Why You’ll Love RentUp

🏠 All-in-One Dashboard
See occupancy rates, upcoming rent, and property details at a glance.

👥 Tenant Profiles
Store names, family details, lease dates and ID proofs—all in one place.

💵 Smart Rent Tracking
Color-coded badges show ✅ Paid • 🕒 Due Soon • ⚠️ Overdue

📜 Payment History
Full log of dates, amounts and notes—exportable as a PDF report.

📁 Secure Document Vault
Keep agreements, ID scans and receipts organized and encrypted.

🔌 Offline Mode
Work anywhere—even without Wi-Fi—and sync when you’re back online.

☁️ Auto Backup & Restore
Never worry about lost data—automatic cloud backups with one-tap restore.

🔐 Biometric Security
Lock the app with fingerprint or Face ID for peace of mind.

📲 Flexible Sign-In
Google, email—or try guest mode for a quick test drive.

🔧 Built for Real-World Property Management
RentUp’s clean interface cuts out the clutter so you can focus on what matters—your properties and your tenants. No lengthy setups, no confusing menus, just intuitive controls designed for busy landlords and managers.

🔒 Rock-Solid Privacy & Security
Your data belongs to you. We use bank-level encryption, secure backups, and biometric locks so you can rest easy.

👤 Perfect For

Solo landlords

Property management firms

Real estate investors

Small & medium rental portfolios

🚀 Ready to simplify your rental business?
Download RentUp today and take control of your properties—one tap at a time.

show_hn.title: Show HN: RentUp – I built a rent manager for my parents

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built RentUp to stop juggling spreadsheets and missing tenant calls—especially for landlords who find modern apps too complex (like my parents).

RentUp keeps it simple:
* Large, color-coded rent badges  
* Auto reminders for leases, maintenance, and tenant calls  
* Secure document vault with biometric lock  
* Works offline + guest sign-in (zero friction)

Tech: Kotlin • Jetpack Compose • Firebase Auth/Firestore • WorkManager

I’m looking for feedback on:
* Readability & UI clarity at a glance  
* Call-reminder flow—does it make sense?  
* Scaling the UI for dozens of properties without clutter

Thanks, and excited to hear your thoughts!
